name: Readabler
notes: Puts Readabler's accessibility button in the bottom left corner, 30 px from the edges, so it never sits on a chatbot bubble (AI Engine and most chat plugins use the bottom right, which is also Readabler's default). The accessibility popup opens in the middle of the screen, the page can still scroll while it is open, and a click outside closes it. The analyzer stays on, but without its column in post lists, its box in the editor and its admin bar item, for quieter admin screens (Readable list columns also removes the column). The button's and popup's colours are left alone: Readabler's colours cannot follow a dark mode switcher, so turn on Readabler colours (Content tab) for the Kadence palette in light and dark mode, or set fixed colours in Readabler. Readabler stores each tab's settings as one option and fills any missing setting with its default, so applying before Readabler's screen was saved is safe. Settings are read on each page, so nothing needs saving again.

mdp_readabler_open_button_settings.butto.label: Position
mdp_readabler_open_button_settings.butto.description: Where the floating accessibility button shows on the page. Bottom left keeps it clear of chatbot bubbles.

mdp_readabler_open_button_settings.butto.label: Margin
mdp_readabler_open_button_settings.butto.description: Space between the button and the edges of the screen, in pixels.

mdp_readabler_modal_popup_settings.popup.label: Close anywhere
mdp_readabler_modal_popup_settings.popup.description: A click outside the popup closes it.
